patch_description:
Replace the locally greedy tree growth with an exact directed-Steiner dynamic program for normal-sized destination sets. The current greedy approach can commit to a cheap early branch that prevents a substantially cheaper shared backbone from being selected later. The subset dynamic program explicitly minimizes the union cost of all broadcast edges by combining destination subsets at shared relay nodes and relaxing those shared subtrees backwards through the network.

For larger destination sets, retain a scalable shared-tree fallback, but validate numeric prices and exclude source-incoming links, self loops, and invalid pricing consistently. The resulting topology still uses the existing BroadCastTopology contract and assigns every partition the selected shared route, permitting downstream transfer overlap.
